purpose: Thai public holidays used by the debt-reminder send window (พระราชบัญญัติการทวงถามหนี้ พ.ศ. 2558 มาตรา 8: contact until 20:00 on weekdays, 18:00 on public holidays).
policy: NEVER add a date from memory, news articles, or a private calendar. Transcribe only from the official announcement.
Each year entry must name the official source and the date the operator verified it.
A day that is a holiday for EITHER the Cabinet list (soc.go.th) or the Bank of Thailand financial-institution list (bot.or.th) is treated as a holiday — the stricter window wins.
Special (cabinet-approved) holidays must be recorded with kind='special' so they can be audited separately.
When a year has no entry, the debt-reminder cron refuses to send for that year. Missing data is not read as 'no holiday today'.

official_sources.cabinet_public_holidays: https://www.soc.go.th/ (สำนักเลขาธิการคณะรัฐมนตรี — วันหยุดราชการประจำปี)
official_sources.royal_gazette: https://ratchakitcha.soc.go.th/ (ประกาศวันหยุดราชการ / วันหยุดเพิ่มเป็นกรณีพิเศษ)

runtime_override: The cron reads app_configs['debt-reminder-holiday-calendar']; this file documents the schema and the approved sources. Operators may seed the same JSON into app_configs without a deploy.
